mapper.select: SELECT c.CATEGORY_ID as "categoryId", c.CATEGORY_CODE as "categoryCode", c.CATEGORY_NAME as "categoryName", c.PARENT_ID as "parentId", c.CATEGORY_LEVEL as "level", c.SORT_ORDER as "sort", c.STATUS as "status", c.UPDATE_TIME as "updateTime", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_INVENTORY_MASTER m WHERE m.CATEGORY_ID = c.CATEGORY_ID AND m.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND m.DELETED = 0) as "inventoryCount" FROM TBL_INVENTORY_CATEGORY c WHERE c.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND c.DELETED = 0 ORDER BY c.SORT_ORDER ASC, c.CATEGORY_ID ASC

SELECT INVENTORY_ID as "inventoryId", INVENTORY_CODE as "inventoryCode", INVENTORY_NAME as "inventoryName", SPECIFICATION as "specification", MODEL as "model", UNIT_NAME as "unitName", CURRENT_QUANTITY as "currentQuantity", STATUS as "status" FROM TBL_INVENTORY_MASTER WHERE CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY INVENTORY_CODE ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_INVENTORY_CATEGORY SET SORT_ORDER = #{sortOrder}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId}
UPDATE TBL_INVENTORY_CATEGORY SET CATEGORY_PATH = #{categoryPath}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId}
